description: Shows a doctor's Tebaba website at the doctor's own domain. Group ours proves to Tebaba that the domain is the doctor's. Group apex points the domain itself at the Tebaba website, group www points its www name there. The addresses are fixed in the template. Nameservers and email records are never written.
variableDescription: challenge: Tebaba's ownership code for this domain, 32 lower-case hex characters
